summary: Yiren Digital Ltd. announced a new share repurchase program authorized by its board to buy back up to 10% of outstanding shares or ADSs for up to $20 million over 12 months, effective July 2, 2026. Repurchases may occur in open market, private transactions, block trades, or through Rule 10b5-1 plans, funded from existing cash. No advisor is named. The program is discretionary, subject to market conditions, and may be adjusted by the board. As a capital-return initiative, the key watchpoint is the pace of repurchases and any potential signal about management's view of undervaluation, with no risk-arb angle.
